name: SEIS mobile shell contract
purpose: Mobile surface for SEIS status, build review, and plugin health.

data_contract.rule: Screens consume the same entity shapes as the web cockpit; no mobile-only state.

screens.title: SEIS Status
screens.purpose: Branch mirror, consolidation state, and gate states at a glance.

screens.title: Build Review
screens.purpose: Weekly build review event, Drive operating docs, and backlog mirror.

screens.title: Plugin Health
screens.purpose: Installed counts, lane breakdown, and OpenAI-first policy compliance.

scaffold_plan.approved: 2026-06-13: owner approved the Expo runtime; deps declared in SEISMobile/package.json, node_modules not vendored.
scaffold_plan.first_smoke_test: npm run android renders the Status screen from src/data/status.json on the Android emulator.
